title: paracynoglossum lanceolatum
intro: Paracynoglossum lanceolatum, commonly known as Lance-leaved Hound's-tongue, is a perennial plant species native to Europe. The health benefits of Lance-leaved Hound's-tongue include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as inflammation and respiratory issues. It is believed to have therapeutic actions as an anti-inflammatory and expectorant, helping to relieve congestion and soothe irritated tissues. The bioactive constituents of Lance-leaved Hound's-tongue include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
